name: workout-tracker
description: Personal workout tracker — web app + Capacitor iOS shell for native HealthKit access

scripts.build:vendor: mkdir -p vendor && esbuild firebase-sync.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020,safari16 --outfile=vendor/firebase-sync.bundle.js && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.js vendor/chart.umd.js
scripts.build:web: npm run build:vendor && rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/vendor && cp index.html app.js styles.css capacitor-health.js manifest.json service-worker.js icon-180.png icon-192.png icon-512.png www/ && cp vendor/*.js www/vendor/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run cap:sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'id=00008150-000548D13EDB401C' -derivedDataPath ../build build | grep -E 'error:|BUILD (SUCCEEDED|FAILED)'
scripts.ios:install: xcrun devicectl device install app --device 4CEFC94E-E22D-5C9A-B14A-DDC94AE4E8C9 ios/build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/App.app && xcrun devicectl device process launch --device 4CEFC94E-E22D-5C9A-B14A-DDC94AE4E8C9 com.layorjunia.workouttracker
scripts.ios:deploy: npm run ios:build && npm run ios:install
